newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: US aid for Sri Lanka to buy 55,000 tonnes of wheat.
newsitem.headline: US aid for Sri Lanka to buy 55,000 tonnes of wheat.

text.p: The United States is providing Sri Lanka $10 million in long-term, low-interest aid to buy about 55,000 tonnes of wheat, the U.S. embassy in Colombo said on Thursday.
The quantity represents some six percent of the country's annual wheat imports, it said in a statement.
The 1997 PL-480 Title 1 agreement allows Sri Lanka 30 years to repay the loan, with a five year grace period, it said.
The interest rate is three percent per year during the first five years, and four percent per year thereafter, it said.
